Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.diagnostic

Class FluidDiagnostics

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.diagnostic.FluidDiagnostics
@Environment(CLIENT) public final class FluidDiagnostics extends Object
/sb fluids: walks every registered source fluid and mirrors the Big and Source Bucket bar-color path so a modpack's fluids can be checked for ones that render as the fallback color or collapse to near-black. Client-only: the tint and still texture exist only on the physical client. On a dedicated server an operator runs this from a connected client and the report lands there.
